title: REQ · A compact header overlay shows logo, world, round state, countdown, sound toggle and settings
summary: HeaderOverlay component wired into App with store flags
description: Context: RoundBadge and Countdown render loose inside the scene; no logo, world name, round ID, sound or settings controls; a failed round API shows only 'Round unavailable'. Desired behavior: HeaderOverlay absolutely positioned at the top of the scene shows a Lucide logo with StoryForge text, world name, round ID, RoundBadge, Countdown, a sound toggle (Volume2/VolumeX) bound to soundEnabled and a settings button that sets settingsOpen; with a round error it shows the failure message. Why: required compact header and explained errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round, when HeaderOverlay renders, then it shows StoryForge, the world name, the round id, the status and a countdown
Given the sound toggle clicked, when the store is read, then soundEnabled flips and aria-pressed matches
Given the settings button clicked, when the store is read, then settingsOpen is true
Given an error prop and no round, when rendered, then the error message text is visible instead of a bare 'Round unavailable'
Given App rendered after Begin, when inspected, then HeaderOverlay is present and the Suggest button opens via the store modal
